ShortDescription.Value: Clean death, or self manage with Funeral Director; Bonus Status report.

Publish.LongDescription:
Control Crematoriums and Cemetaries without in-city bloat that reduces performance.
- Yes - you can use just death Status Report and nothing else! - Choose if you want to self manage with all your own settings for Process rate or number of hearses - or if you prefer auto-clean of dead bodies.
### Option 1: Auto Clean
- Removes already dead citizens with auto magic when they are waiting for a hearse. - Great for death-waves and notification spam. Lightweight design for best city performance.
### Option 2: Funeral Director (Self manage)
Tune deathcare values:
- Processing rate (crematoriums) - Fleet size (max hearses per facility) - Cemetery storage multiplier - Hearse speed (pedal to the metal) - Max Workers - now updates Existing buildings (not just new ones). - Compatibility Toggle ✅ turn OFF workers if you prefer to use ConfigXML mod or other mod for death worker numbers. - Funeral Director does not run per-frame; sliders make changes, then mod goes idle (basically no city performance impact). - Everything is Optional!
## Bonus Status Report - All major death stats - finally we know how many are Dead!! - Scan only happen in the Options menu or when a slider is used (lightweight, no city per-frame impact).
## Features - Toggle on/off without restarting the game. - Safe to remove any time. Uncheck both boxes to disable everything. - Disable other hearse mods to avoid conflicts! - Use either Auto-clean OR Self-manage (mutually exclusive). - No Harmony (more reliable on patch days).
## Support and Feedback - If the mod works for you, give it a Like! It's free! - Feedback: GitHub or Discord links on the right.
## Credits - River-Mochi: author - Inspired by Wayz's original Magical Hearse (retired) - yenyang: technical consultant - Necko1996: testing, screenshots - StarQ: tech advisory - Toud: Polish translation review.
## How it works
- Magic mode ✅ if the citizen is flagged as dead and needs transport, it's cleaned up. Looks like magic but the secret is flags. - Mod does not stop death - it's just very fast corpse cleanup. - Safe removal: if you use Auto-Magic, nothing persists - done. If you used sliders, set sliders to 100% and uncheck Funeral Director, save city one time (fastest reset). - Bonus: disable all checkboxes ✅, turns off all mod death work, and still see real Status reports in the Options menu. - Status only works when inside the menu; no performance impact to in-game city.
